rationale: Within the mapping’s qualitative comparison by inconsistent items, a row rated consistent with every hypothesis supplies no differential inconsistency. Flagging it as non-discriminating and setting it aside from that comparison is warranted; this does not establish that it has no evidential value outside that comparison.
signal_basis: The observable is the filled matrix: a comparative pattern showing which hypotheses accumulate inconsistent items, which items discriminate, and which conclusions shift under the sensitivity test. It is not any single document.
